newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: U.S. plane makes emergency landing in Australia.
newsitem.headline: U.S. plane makes emergency landing in Australia.

text.p: A U.S. airforce plane with 19 people aboard made an emergency landing in Australia on Saturday night after fire broke out in one of its engines, police said.
The Boeing 707, used as an in-flight refueller, touched down in the northern city of Brisbane without incident after the pilot shut down the stricken engine.
The plane was on its way from Brisbane to Honolulu when the crew were alerted to a fire alarm in one of its four engines and turned back. The fire was extinguished before landing.
The aircraft was in Australia to take part in joint U.S.-Australian war games, Tandem Thrust, north of Brisbane.
